title: Gardening Shoes And Garden Gnomes
summary: Discover some surprising (and not so surprising) similarities your favorite pair of Allbirds gardening shoes may have in common with garden gnomes.
body_markdown:
Anyone who has spent a day tending to their garden knows that it's more than just a hobby—it's a peaceful escape, a chance to connect with nature, and a fulfilling way to express yourself. Plus, as an added bonus, it’s just nice to have a gorgeous garden!


In the whimsical world of gardening where each bloom holds a tale, there are certain allies that can instantly make your experience better: garden gnomes and amazingly comfy gardening shoes.


So let’s take a fun journey to discover how these pint-sized guardians of the garden and your favorite gardening shoes make this hobby that much better!


## They Make Gardening So Much More Enjoyable


Just like a friendly garden gnome adds eccentric charm (and some company) to your outdoor space, the right pair of gardening shoes can elevate your gardening experience from mundane to magical.


Picture this: You step out into your garden, greeted by the morning sun and birds chirping. All is well. As you bend down to plant your favorite flowers or pull out pesky weeds, your feet sink comfortably into the soft earth. With cushioned soles and[breathable materials](http://www.allbirds.com/pages/renewable-materials) , your gardening shoes should provide the comfort and support you need to spend hours tending to your plants without feeling fatigued.


Whether you're digging, planting, or pruning, the right pair of gardening shoes will keep your feet happy and your spirits high, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the joys of gardening.


## They Can Withstand the Elements


Garden gnomes are known for their resilience, standing tall (or short) in rain or shine, and your gardening shoes should be no exception. From unexpected showers and navigating muddy paths to dealing with unexpected puddles or early morning dew, your shoes should be able to withstand whatever nature throws their way. Water-resistant shoes, like those found in our[Mizzles collection](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/mens-mizzles) , are ideal for keeping your feet dry while taking on your gardening tasks. And if you need a little more ankle coverage to keep sediment out, the[Wool Runner-Up Mizzles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-runner-up-mizzles) have you covered—literally. At least, your ankles.


## They Should Come in Happy Little Pairs


Just as garden gnomes often come in happy little pairs to keep each other company, your gardening shoes come in pairs to accompany you on your gardening escapades. Even if they are retired from daily wear, having a dedicated pair of gardening shoes ensures optimal comfort and support while you cultivate your garden oasis that doubles as a dwelling space for your family of gnomes.


## They Can Be Colorful and Speak to Your Personality


Chubby gnomes with handkerchiefs around their heads? Santa-esque grumpy guys? One of the many joys of having garden gnomes is picking your favorites & assigning them names (and even personalities, in some cases). And you’ve probably got your favorite gardening shoes—the tried and true sneakers that make you smile.


Ready for a new pair of gardening shoes? We recommend going with our shoes with water-resistant outers, such as the[Wool Runner Mizzles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-runner-mizzles-savanna-night-navy?price-tiers=msrp) ,[Wool Runner-Up Mizzles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-runner-up-mizzles) , and the[Wool Dasher Mizzles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-dasher-mizzles) . The slip-on, slip-off[Loungers](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/womens-loungers) are also an excellent choice because you can get them on and off quickly. And when it’s time to clean them up, don’t forget about our[tips on how to wash your Allbirds](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/how-to-wash-running-shoes) .


Happy gardening!
